newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Federal Signal EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Federal Signal EPS cut.

text.p: -- Everen Securities said Friday it cut its second quarter earnings estimate for Federal Signal Corp by $0.03 a share to $0.32, and its 1997 estimate by $0.03 to $1.50.
-- Everen said it cut its second-quarter estimate due to weak incoming order rates in the first quarter.
-- Federal Signal reported first quarter earnings of $0.30 a share, versus $0.26, which met Everen's estimate of $0.29 to $0.30.
-- The rating remains market performer near term and outperform long-term.
-- Federal Signal shares were unchanged at 25-3/8.
